bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 171, Number 123 (Thursday, July 17, 2025)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. STEUBE:
H.R. 4534.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I Section 8
[Page H3477]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Education and Workforce, and in addition to the Committee on Armed Services, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
